Requirements You are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Cursebound]{Cursebound 4}.

Your mind and body can, for a short time and with great peril, surpass the final limits of your curse. For 1 minute, you shed torrential flames, become surrounded by spirits, or otherwise overflow with divine power in a way that suits your mystery. On each of your turns during that time, you can cast one revelation spell without spending Focus Points.

At the end of the minute, the durations of any revelation spells you cast during that time end, and you must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:40] save.

Critical Success You aren't otherwise affected.

Success You are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Drained]{Drained 2} and can't reduce or remove this condition until your next preparations.

Failure You are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Drained]{Drained 4} and can't reduce or remove this condition until your next preparations.

Critical Failure You die.

The power of your mystery surges through you like a font of divine energy, even when your own magic dwindles.

Twice per day, you can cast a spell after you've run out of spell slots of the appropriate spell rank; the two spells you cast with this feat must be of different spell ranks.
